title: Careers
intro: We build strong QA processes — and we're looking for people who care about quality, not checklists.
desc: We work with real products and real delivery pipelines. Our QA engineers influence how products are built, tested, and released — not just how bugs are reported.
howToApplyDesc: We respect candidates' time and keep the process clear and predictable
dontSeeRoleDesc:
We're always interested in strong QA engineers.
If you care about quality and ownership — reach out.

senior.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
senior.desc: As a Senior QA Engineer, you will be responsible for driving quality across the product, shaping QA processes, and influencing how teams think about risk and testing.
responsibilities: Design test strategy and test coverage
Lead risk-based testing and regression strategy
Work closely with developers, PMs, and DevOps
Review and improve existing test processes
Mentor Middle and Junior QA engineers
Contribute to automation strategy (not just writing tests)
requirements: Strong experience in QA engineering 4+ years
Deep understanding of testing principles and quality risks
Experience with web applications and APIs
benefits: Freedom to improve QA, not just follow instructions
Professional growth in QA, automation, and delivery processes

middle.title: General Middle QA Engineer
middle.desc: As a Middle QA Engineer, you will work on real projects, improve your testing skills, and grow towards a strong, independent QA role.
responsibilities: Perform manual testing of web applications and APIs
Write and maintain test cases and checklists
Collaborate with developers and senior QA engineers
requirements: Understanding of QA fundamentals and testing types
Deep understanding of web technologies (HTTP, REST, browsers)
benefits: Clear growth path to Senior QA
